senses.gloss: m. (מָאֵן) a woman’s protest against a marriage contracted during her minority, annulment of marriage.
units: Yeb. XIII, 4 גט אחר מ׳ a divorce issued after annulment (her husband having remarried her after annulment and then divorced her); מ׳ אחר גט annulment following divorce (having divorced and remarried her during minority). Ib. 108ᵃ; Tosef. ib. XIII, 1 (איזהו) כיצד מ׳ in what way is miun performed? Ib. אין לך מ׳ גדול מזה there can be no surer protest than this; a. v. fr.—Pl. מִיאוּנִים, מִיאוּנִין. Ib. שטרי מ׳ (Yeb. 107ᵇ גט מיאון) letters of protest.
<cite ref="Yevamot 108a:5">Yeb. 108ᵃ</cite> <he>קידושיה הן הן מִיאוּנֶיהָ</he> her betrothal (to another man) serves as a declaration of protest.
